# TUI configuration

Settings for SASE's terminal interface and its configurable panes.

Defaults come from the schema when declared, otherwise from the bundled YAML. An object
with listed children is expanded below; `{…}` and `[…]` summarize compound defaults. A
dash means the schema has no finite allowed-value list.

| <a id="ace-artifacts-stitches"></a>`ace.artifacts.stitches`                                                           | object            | {`default_query`} (values below)                                                              | —                                                                                                     | Settings for the Artifacts Stitches pane                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| <a id="ace-artifacts-stitches-default_query"></a>`ace.artifacts.stitches.default_query`                               | string            | `"sidecar:false merges:hide since:24h"`                                                       | —                                                                                                     | Canonical query loaded into the persistent Stitches filter when sase's TUI starts. One singular, non-negatable project: token may use a configured project name, ProjectSpec directory key, or alias; known committed refs are rewritten to the configured name. Otherwise startup adds an explicit TUI-query project or the current registered project when available. After startup, no project: token means all projects. Merge visibility accepts merges:hide, merges:show, or merges:only. Origin accepts origin:stitch, origin:auto, or origin:manual, repeatable and negatable like repo: and author:. Type accepts repeatable and negatable labels including manual, automatic (auto alias), stitch, merge, patch, and observed SASE_TYPE values; it filters commit labels and does not replace merges: visibility. Startup injects limit:&lt;ace.page_size&gt; when the query has no limit token; an explicit limit: (including limit:all) is left alone, and a user-deleted token stays uncapped. Relative date windows re-anchor on refresh; configuration changes take effect in the next sase's TUI process. |

| <a id="ace-notification_rules"></a>`ace.notification_rules`                                                           | array             | `[]`                                                                                          | —                                                                                                     | Ordered client-side notification delivery rules deciding, per notification, whether a TUI toast is shown, how the arrival is announced, and whether the row may be delivered to Telegram. A rule changes announcement only, never whether a notification is stored, read, counted, or listed. A Telegram true never bypasses read/mute/silent, first-run, cursor, or other transport eligibility checks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
